# Liquid Glass in Pilot Ops

The browser fragment shader is adapted from [liquid-glass-skill](https://github.com/Na2H2P2O7/liquid-glass-skill/blob/fdb7d507a773cc93500b4c8c807a3cd90c4ce5af/assets/glass.js), by Jerome Chiao, under the accompanying MIT license. Our local host replaces the desktop bridge, live capture, and wallpaper handling with a fixed, same-origin relief texture. No device permission, account, CDN, or paid service is involved.

One demand-driven WebGL context shades only the measured header and navigation rectangles. Rounded clipping, guarded setup/context restoration, size limits, and graphite tints are Pilot Ops adaptations. Text, charts, routes, and alerts stay in the normal app layers. Reduced motion disables press animation. Solid appearance, reduced transparency, forced colors, and unavailable WebGL use the ordinary CSS shell.
